title: Less waiting between text requests
summary:
Text requests get through the per-IP queue sooner, while model defaults and image feed handling get more precise.

Text requests from the same IP are now spaced 6 seconds apart instead of 12. Image feed handling also maps `private=true` to `nofeed` and filters private events from non-NSFW listeners.

Requests without `max_tokens` now use defaults of 4,000 for Llamaguard and 7,168 for Llama 3.1 8B Instruct, helping avoid Llamaguard context-window errors. Claude 3.5 Haiku and Hormoz 8B were also moved onto the shared Portkey route.

Claude 3.5 Haiku handler errors now return a chat completion with a donation request and a `donation_request` flag. The web search tool now defaults to 3 results and advertises a range of 1–7.

highlights.title: Shorter text request spacing
highlights.text: Text requests from the same IP are now spaced 6 seconds apart instead of 12, reducing the wait between queued requests.

highlights.title: Private image feed handling
highlights.text: Image requests with `private=true` are now treated as `nofeed` for feed handling, and private events are filtered from non-NSFW listeners.
